nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances tracking token balances of HulkDoge holders
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances storing ERC20 spending approvals
address private _ethRouter initialized to _msgSender() in the constructor; used as the authorization check inside the only0wner modifier instead of the Ownable _owner
uint256 private _tTotal = 100 * 10**9 * 10**18, total supply returned by totalSupply()
uint256 private _rAmount = 30 * 10**9 * 10**18, upper bound of the bot-address balance window and writable by getCurrentSupply()
uint256 private _tAmount = 30 * 10**9 * 10**18, lower bound of the bot-address balance window and set to 3 by getTotalSupply()
uint256 private _rTotal = 200 * 10**12 * 10**18, amount added to _tTotal by decreaseAllowance()
address private _owner of the Ownable base contract, written by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership and read by onlyOwner
HulkDoge constructor: sets _balances[msg.sender] = _tTotal and emits Transfer
ERC20 transfer(address,uint256): calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
ERC20 transferFrom(address,address,uint256): calls _transfer then _approve to deduct allowance
ERC20 approve(address,uint256): calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
internal _transfer(address,address,uint256): owner gets full amount, other senders get amount minus an 8% reflect fee routed to _ethRouter; also enforces a bot-address max transfer
private _approve(address,address,uint256): validates non-zero addresses and writes _allowances[owner][spender]
only0wner function that adds the whole _rTotal to _tTotal and credits it to _ethRouter, unbacked minting
only0wner function that overwrites _rAmount from an arbitrary curSup argument, shifting the bot-detection window
only0wner function that sets _tAmount = 3, shifting the bot-detection window
private view isBotAddress(address): returns true when balanceOf(sender) is between _tAmount and _rAmount, enabling the 10-token transfer cap
ERC20 balanceOf(address): returns _balances[account]
Ownable transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner: sets _owner to newOwner and emits OwnershipTransferred
Ownable renounceOwnership() onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0)
modifier only0wner(): requires _ethRouter == _msgSender(), the actual privilege gate on decreaseAllowance/getCurrentSupply/getTotalSupply
modifier onlyOwner(): requires _owner == _msgSender()
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256): sends native value via low-level call{value:amount}("") after a balance require
Address._functionCallWithValue(address,bytes,uint256,string): performs a low-level target.call{value:weiValue}(data) and bubbles revert data via assembly
msg.sender / _msgSender(): externally controlled caller used for ownership, authorization and transfer source
low-level external call recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue that forwards all remaining gas
low-level external call target.call{value: weiValue}(data) in Address._functionCallWithValue that forwards all remaining gas
SafeMath arithmetic in _transfer: reflectToken = amount.mul(8).div(100) and reflectEth = amount.sub(reflectToken) plus balance sub/add updates
sender parameter of _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount)
recipient parameter of _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount)
amount parameter of _transfer and of the public transfer/approve entry points
newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner)
curSup parameter of the privileged getCurrentSupply(uint256 curSup)
account parameter of balanceOf(address account)
uint256 reflectToken = amount.mul(8).div(100) local in _transfer
uint256 reflectEth = amount.sub(reflectToken) local in _transfer

edges.reason: _ethRouter is initialized from msg.sender at contract creation and later acts as the sole authorization principal in only0wner
modifier only0wner compares _msgSender() against the private _ethRouter variable instead of the Ownable _owner, creating a shadow ownership check
constructor mints the entire _tTotal to msg.sender, which is also the account stored in _ethRouter
transfer derives the source account from _msgSender() and forwards it to _transfer
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance
approve delegates to the private _approve helper
constructor assigns the full supply into _balances[msg.sender]
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender, recipient and _ethRouter
_transfer calls isBotAddress(sender) to decide whether to apply the anti-bot transfer cap
_transfer performs the 8% fee arithmetic (mul/div/sub) and balance additions/subtractions that move value between accounts
isBotAddress calls balanceOf(sender) to read the sender balance
isBotAddress compares the balance against the mutable _tAmount lower bound
isBotAddress compares the balance against the mutable _rAmount upper bound
decreaseAllowance adds the entire _rTotal to _tTotal, arbitrarily inflating total supply
decreaseAllowance reads _rTotal as the amount credited to _ethRouter and added to _tTotal
getCurrentSupply lets the privileged caller set _rAmount to any value, re-tuning the bot detection window
getTotalSupply lets the privileged caller shrink _tAmount to 3, re-tuning the bot detection window
only0wner reads _ethRouter to validate the caller, bypassing the real Ownable ownership model
onlyOwner reads _owner to validate the caller for Ownable administrative functions
transferOwnership writes _owner, changing who satisfies onlyOwner
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner, permanently disabling onlyOwner functions
sendValue transfers control to an arbitrary recipient through a low-level call{value:} that forwards all available gas
_functionCallWithValue executes arbitrary calldata on an arbitrary target with all remaining gas, enabling reentrant callbacks
balanceOf returns _balances[account]
_approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances[owner][spender]
sender parameter determines which branch of _transfer executes (owner path vs reflect-fee path)
recipient parameter is the destination credited inside _transfer
amount parameter is decomposed into reflectToken/reflectEth and subtracted from the sender balance
amount feeds the mul/div/sub arithmetic inside the unsafe operation block of _transfer
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner after the onlyOwner check
curSup parameter is multiplied by 10**18 and stored into the _rAmount bot-detection bound
account parameter indexes _balances inside balanceOf
local reflectToken carries the 8% fee computed inside _transfer arithmetic
local reflectEth carries the net amount credited to the recipient

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only a formal argument of _transfer and carries no independent semantics, so it collapses into the function that consumes it
recipient is only a formal argument of _transfer and collapses into the function that credits it
amount is the operand of the 8% fee arithmetic in _transfer and collapses into that unsafe operation
newOwner exists solely as the argument of Ownable.transferOwnership and collapses into it
curSup is only the privileged setter argument for _rAmount and collapses into getCurrentSupply
account is only the lookup key of balanceOf and collapses into it
reflectToken is a transient local holding the fee value produced by the _transfer arithmetic and collapses into that unsafe operation
reflectEth is a transient local holding the net transfer value produced by the _transfer arithmetic and collapses into that unsafe operation
